target.title: chore(docker): bundle channel voice plugin deps
target.body:
## Summary

- Problem: default Docker builds pruned optional bundled plugin runtime dependencies unless operators knew to set `OPENCLAW_EXTENSIONS`.
- Why it matters: Discord, Feishu, and Voice Call are externalized plugin packages but should be ready in the standard Docker image path.
- What changed: default Docker image builds now include bundled plugin ids `discord`, `feishu`, and `voice-call`; `scripts/docker/setup.sh` uses the same default.
- What did NOT change: operators can still pass `OPENCLAW_EXTENSIONS=` to build a slimmer image without optional bundled plugin deps.

## Change Type (select all)

- [x] Docs
- [x] Chore/infra

## Scope (select all touched areas)

- [x] Integrations
- [x] CI/CD / infra

## Real behavior proof (required for external PRs)

- Behavior or issue addressed: default Docker setup/image-build inputs now include the bundled plugin ids `discord feishu voice-call`, while an explicitly empty `OPENCLAW_EXTENSIONS=` remains an opt-out.
- Real environment tested: Linux repo checkout, Node 22.22.0, Docker setup-script command path exercised through the repository Docker setup harness; full container image build is left to the PR image-build check.
- Exact steps or command run after this patch: `corepack pnpm test src/dockerfile.test.ts src/docker-setup.e2e.test.ts` and `corepack pnpm exec oxfmt --check --threads=1 Dockerfile scripts/docker/setup.sh docs/install/docker.md src/dockerfile.test.ts src/docker-setup.e2e.test.ts CHANGELOG.md`.
- Evidence after fix (screenshot, recording, terminal capture, console output, redacted runtime log, linked artifact, or copied live output): copied terminal output:

```text
[test] starting test/vitest/vitest.unit-fast.config.ts
Test Files  1 passed (1)
Tests  14 passed (14)

[test] starting test/vitest/vitest.e2e.config.ts
Test Files  1 passed (1)
Tests  28 passed (28)

[test] passed 2 Vitest shards in 12.88s

Checking formatting...
All matched files use the correct format.
Finished in 5469ms on 4 files using 1 threads.
```

- Observed result after fix: the Docker setup harness output included `--build-arg OPENCLAW_EXTENSIONS=discord feishu voice-call` for default setup and preserved `--build-arg OPENCLAW_EXTENSIONS=` for the explicit empty opt-out path.
- What was not tested: full Docker image build locally; I am monitoring PR CI for image-build proof.
- Before evidence (optional but encouraged): before this patch, `Dockerfile` defaulted `ARG OPENCLAW_EXTENSIONS=""`, and `scripts/docker/setup.sh` exported an empty `OPENCLAW_EXTENSIONS` default.

## User-visible / Behavior Changes

Default Docker image builds include Discord, Feishu, and Voice Call plugin runtime dependencies. Custom slim builds can opt out with `OPENCLAW_EXTENSIONS=`.

## Security Impact (required)

- New permissions/capabilities? (`Yes/No`) No
- Secrets/tokens handling changed? (`Yes/No`) No
- New/changed network calls? (`Yes/No`) No
- Command/tool execution surface changed? (`Yes/No`) No
- Data access scope changed? (`Yes/No`) No
- If any `Yes`, explain risk + mitigation: N/A

## Repro + Verification

```text
corepack pnpm docs:list
corepack pnpm test src/dockerfile.test.ts src/docker-setup.e2e.test.ts
corepack pnpm exec oxfmt --check --threads=1 Dockerfile scripts/docker/setup.sh docs/install/docker.md src/dockerfile.test.ts src/docker-setup.e2e.test.ts CHANGELOG.md
git diff --check
```

## Human Verification (required)

- Verified scenarios: Dockerfile default, setup-script default, explicit empty `OPENCLAW_EXTENSIONS` opt-out, Docker docs formatting.
- Edge cases checked: explicit empty env var does not fall back to defaults.
- What you did not verify: full Docker image build locally; this PR relies on the image-build CI for that proof.

## Compatibility / Migration

- Backward compatible? (`Yes/No`) Yes
- Config/env changes? (`Yes/No`) Yes
- Migration needed? (`Yes/No`) No
- If yes, exact upgrade steps: none; set `OPENCLAW_EXTENSIONS=` to keep the previous slim optional-plugin behavior.

## Risks and Mitigations

- Risk: default Docker images include more plugin dependencies.
  - Mitigation: document and test `OPENCLAW_EXTENSIONS=` as an opt-out.
